description: Hand labels for every paper cited by the two stored example AI walks of job Ku5jMVCL6z (scopes 'network' and 'pathway:mmu04068', 26 + 10 papers, 36 distinct PMIDs) plus the 17 PubMed IDs cited by the TRRUST v2 mouse Ikzf1 rows and the three Ikaros papers used for ikaros_targets.json. Each abstract was fetched with efetch (db=pubmed, retmode=xml) and read; MeSH headings were consulted only as a cross-check. 'unknown' is used where the abstract does not say.
